For every compact competitor choose phase-aligned inputs in disjoint depth bands; these are weakly null in ell-infinity by bounded finite-additive variation, and hence compact images tend to zero. This establishes equality for all positive weights and both norms. The weighted-ray E_K=2^-K is verified analytically. The standalone checker executed 21537 finite assertions. No inference from finite tests to infinite theorem is made.

value.rationale: The exact essential norm and compactness criterion solve a natural quantitative gap in big nonseparable tree Lipschitz multiplier theory, beyond published inequalities. The distinction from little spaces is mathematically substantive: the finite-prefix cancellation permits a compact multiplier with persistent weighted derivative, which a little-space calculation cannot cover. Arbitrary positive weights unify unweighted and fast-growing-weight regimes without introducing artificial parameter restrictions. A sharp complete classification of this natural invariant is valuable without needing a downstream theorem.
